name: Sentinel
body:
Ahead of war parties and in the wild borders of lands, there are scouting parties. The sentinel is a savvy protector who excels at guerrilla combat, scout group leadership and the screening of their fellow scouts.

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

Sentinels are only proficient with only light armor and shields. This alters the vanguard’s normal proficiencies.

Class Skills: A sentinel adds Escape Artist, Knowledge (nature), Knowledge (geography) and Stealth to their class skills. However, they remove Appraise, Diplomacy, Knowledge (nobility), Knowledge (history), Linguistics and Perform from their list of class skills. This modifies the vanguard’s class skills.

Survival Training (Ex)

A sentinel is trained to understand the skills required to survive in the wilds on the borders of their lands or deep in enemy territory. At 2nd level, the sentinel gains a bonus equal to 1/2 their class levels on Knowledge (nature), Knowledge (geography), Survival and Stealth checks.

This ability replaces aristocratic training.

Dodge (Ex)

The sentinel needs to know how to avoid damage. At 2nd level, the sentinel gains Dodge as a bonus feat. At 8th level and every 6 levels thereafter the bonus granted by the Dodge feat increases by an additional +1. You only receive the benefit of the Dodge feat and the extra AC bonus if in light or no armor.

This ability replaces shield focus.

Guerrilla Tactics (Ex)

A sentinel is a master of hitand-run tactics. At 2nd level, the sentinel gains the Mobility and Run feats as bonus feats as long as they are wearing light or no armor. At 6th level, if the sentinel moves 10 feet or more in a round and makes a single attack they add an additional damage die to their attack as per the Vital Strike feat. An additional die is added at 11th and 16th levels. The additional die of damage are only applied if the sentinel is wearing light or no armor, though may be used in conjunction with a charge.

This ability replaces weapons of the guardian.

This ability counts as Vital Strike for prerequisite purposes. At 11th level, it counts also as Improved Vital Strike and at 16th it counts as Greater Vital Strike.

Screen Them (Ex)

At 3rd level, the sentinel may charge forth to defend an ally. This ability operates as the behind me ability except that the sentinel may make a move as an immediate action to get themselves within 5 feet of their charge prior to enacting the ability. To do so, the sentinel must make an Acrobatics check with a DC equal to 1/2 the feet of required movement, up to the sentinel’s double move distance. However, any movement used in this ability is deducted from the sentinel’s movement in their next turn. This ability modifies behind me.

Nimble Combatant (Ex)

A sentinel needs to be able to weave through their enemies. At 3rd level, a sentinel may take 10 on Acrobatics to move through threatened squares. At 9th level, the sentinel can move at normal speed while using Acrobatics to move through threatened squares. At 15th level, the sentinel may take 20 on these Acrobatics checks.

This ability replaces armor training.

Active Maneuvers (Ex)

The sentinel is trained to use their confidence in their skills to enhance their maneuverability. At 6th level, the sentinel may spend a point of Mettle to apply their Charisma bonus (if any) to their CMD and touch AC, though their touch AC may not exceed their base AC.

At 11th level, the bonus may be applied to their Reflex saves.

At 16th level, these bonuses always apply and do not require a point of Mettle to enact.

This ability only functions if the sentinel is wearing light or no armor.

This ability replaces active defense.

Charging Strikes (Ex)

At 7th level, as a full-round action, the sentinel may make a special charge attack.

The sentinel may make their full attack anywhere along the line of the charge, though each attack must be against a different target. The attacks must be made in the order the sentinel encounters a target and in order of attack iteration. However, the sentinel need not attack every creature in the line. For example, a sentinel may charge past a creature, attack the next creature in the line at their full base attack bonus and the second encountered creature at their second attack bonus. This ability replaced press the advantage and improved press the advantage.
